findings.summary: Removal of reshape(-1) causes 0-D numpy arrays to crash with TypeError instead of being handled gracefully
findings.failure_scenario: Calling model.predict(np.array(42)) passes the supported_input_types check, reaches line 123 where len(np.array(42)) raises TypeError: len() of unsized object. The old code's reshape(-1) converted 0-D to 1-D before the length check.
